title: When the House Turns
author: Ines Oyelaran
blurb: Tamsin Blackwood, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the last resident signs the papers.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
